Let’s Talk Lighting & Lace ✨

A flawless install isn’t just about the products you use—it’s about how you use them.

🤎 HD Lace
For darker skin tones, HD lace is usually my go-to because it gives the best chance of achieving a seamless melt.

💡 Lighting
I always work under a harsh filming light. It exposes product build-up, ashiness and any areas that need improving. If the lace looks good under that light, I know it’ll look even better in everyday lighting.

🎨 Lace Tint
For darker skin tones, I generally prefer a spray lace tint over foundation or powder. Everyone’s skin tone, undertones and scalp colour are different, so the goal is choosing the method that creates the most natural finish for that client.

There isn’t one product that works for everyone—that’s what makes great installs all about technique. ✨
